title: A Look Into Calgary's Past
description: Use the microfiche machine in the Calgary Central Library to view a newspaper that is at least 50 years old.

title: Film an Air Ambulance
description: Film an air ambulance helicopter landing on the roof of the McCaig Tower at the Foothills Hospital

title: Run Backwards
description: Film each other running 100m backwards, and then put the video backwards to see who's run looks more normal

title: Film a Duck
description: Film a duck in the pond at the West Campus Park
Go to Market Mall and compete to see who can find an item with the price closest to $20.26.

title: Birdwatching
description: Identify and photograph 5 different species of birds at Inglewood Bird Sanctuary

title: The Wisdom of the Crowd
description: Ask strangers for the height of the Calgary Tower until the average of all the guesses is within 5 meters of the real value (191 meters)

title: Planespotting
description: Identify and photography a Boeing 737, Airbus A320, and Boeing 787.
place_name: In or around Calgary international Airport

title: Lucky Eights
description: 8 is a lucky number in Chinese culture. In Chinatown, set an eight-minute timer and try to photograph 8 instances of the number 8.
Go to Chinook Centre and compete to see who can find an item with the price closest to $20.26.
Go from Centennial Place to the CORE Shopping Centre only using the 15+ elevated walkway system.

title: Play Ping Pong
description: Play a game of ping-pong up to 13 points on the tables in the Engineering building.

title: Downtown View
description: Go onto the roof of the Art Parkade and take a picture of Downtown. Identify five Downtown buildings in your photo.
